title: Digital That Delivers
subtitle: National Digital Transformation Programme
services: Project Management, Creative Consulting, Visual Design
intro:
## Digital That Delivers

A Fáilte Ireland programme built to strengthen the digital capability of Irish tourism businesses — visitor attractions, activity providers, and tour operators.

Working as Technical Diagnostics Expert within the Website Team across a cohort of 60+ businesses, I conducted structured digital audits, translated findings into Creative Briefs that gave agencies something worth building from, and stayed in as creative partner throughout delivery to ensure the work stayed true to brief.

Stepping up to Lead Consultant, I oversaw a team of Technical Diagnostics Experts, ensuring the same standard of audit, brief, and delivery was maintained consistently across 100+ websites.

Strategic consultancy. Creative direction. Digital auditing. Brief writing. Agency management. End-to-end delivery.
extended:
## Website Accessibility Grant Scheme

The Website Accessibility Grant Scheme (WAGS) is a dedicated strand of the Digital That Delivers programme, focused on bringing Irish tourism websites into compliance with WCAG 2.2 AA – the standard required under the European Accessibility Act 2025.

I played a central role in shaping how the scheme operated in practice: helping to build the programme guidelines, documentation, and delivery workstream that underpinned the website projects across 100+ businesses. This included defining audit methodology, creating accessibility briefs and reporting frameworks, and establishing the standards that delivery agencies were required to meet.

On the ground, I worked directly between businesses and their appointed agencies – reviewing proposals, monitoring scope, and ensuring completed websites met both technical and accessibility requirements before sign-off.

title: Dingle Oceanworld
subtitle: Deep Atlantic Immersive
services: Project Management, Creative Consulting, Visual Design
intro: Dingle Oceanworld commissioned this project with a clear ambition: create Ireland's first fully immersive marine experience. I came on board as creative consultant and project manager, working on behalf of Oceanworld to brief, direct, and deliver the experience alongside Dublin-based immersive studio Algorithm.
extended:
Deep Atlantic takes visitors 200 metres beneath the Atlantic, following a humpback whale along the Porcupine Ridge off the Kerry coast. Projected 360° across every surface of the auditorium using Algorithm's patent-pending Orbit technology, it's a six-minute journey through bioluminescent deep sea – interactive, cinematic, and conservation-led.

I shaped the creative vision, managed the client-agency relationship, and ensured the experience aligned with Oceanworld's education and conservation mission. The experience premiered at the Dingle Animation Festival in March 2023 and remains a permanent exhibit.

title: Collectiv
subtitle: Website Development
services: Web Design & Development, Project Management, Visual Design
intro: Collectiv are a Dublin-based experiential and OOH marketing agency – bold brand activations, murals, special builds, and campaigns for global clients. Their work lives in the real world, at scale, in public space. The website needed to match that ambition.
extended:
I designed and built a new WordPress site to showcase their portfolio, using GSAP animations to bring the work to life through considered motion and transitions. The goal was to create a digital presence that felt as impactful as the activations themselves – giving each campaign the space to land without the site getting in the way.

The result is clean, confident, and built around the work. Prospective clients get an immediate sense of scale, quality, and range – from street-level murals to full brand takeovers – without having to dig for it.

title: Subterranean Soul
subtitle: Visual Design & Graphics
intro: Subterranean Soul is a DJ residency and events collective based in Dingle, running regular club nights and an annual weekender, Siar. I work as their primary designer on an ongoing basis, creating all visual output across print and digital – event posters, social assets, and promotional materials for each night and festival.
extended: The work references the visual language of European underground club culture while staying rooted in the west of Ireland. Bold, graphic, and consistent – built to hold its own in a feed and on a wall.

title: A11YO
subtitle: Accessibility Tool
services: Project Management, Creative Consulting, Visual Design
intro: A11YO is an accessibility and digital readiness checker built for small businesses and agencies who need to know where their website stands – without the overhead of a full manual audit.
extended:
I took the product from concept to live MVP: owning the idea, the UX, the design, and the build. The brief came directly from my own experience leading accessibility programmes across 100+ Irish tourism websites. I kept seeing the same problem – businesses who needed clear, actionable guidance but couldn't access or afford specialist support. A11YO is the answer to that gap.

Designing and building a product solo is a different discipline to client work. Every decision lands on you – what to build, what to cut, how to frame it, how to make it useful to someone who doesn't speak your language. That process sharpened everything: the thinking, the design, the ability to move fast without losing quality.
